content_of_post_to_comment: The newest status symbol is having enough time, money and discipline to turn your body into a visible project. Wellness is beginning to function the way luxury always has: separating people with access from people without it, then recasting that access as personal virtue.
comment: The interesting tension is that wellness can be both a genuine source of agency and a new form of status signaling. The harder question may be how we preserve the benefits without turning health into another measure of social worth.
